struct Edge {
	int from, to;
	int capacity;
	int cost;
	int flow;
	Edge* complement;
};

Edge* compileWD(int n, vector<Edge>& edges) {
	Edge* g = new Edge*[n];
	for (int i = edges.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
		Edge* origin = &edges[i];
		Edge* clone = new Edge(origin->to, origin->from, origin->capacity, -origin->cost);
		clone->flow = origin->capacity;
		clone->complement = origin;
		origin->complement = clone;
		edges.push_back(*clone);
	}
	int* p = new int[n];
	for (Edge& e : edges)p[e.from]++;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)g[i] = new Edge[p[i]];
	for (Edge& e : edges)g[e.from][--p[e.from]] = e;
	return g;
}

struct MinHeap {
	int* a;
	int* map;
	int* imap;
	int n;
	int pos;
	static const int INF = 2147483647;
	MinHeap(int m) {
		n = m + 2;
		a = new int[n];
		map = new int[n];
		imap = new int[n];
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			a[i] = INF;
			map[i] = -1;
			imap[i] = -1;
		}
		pos = 1;
	}
	int add(int ind, int x) {
		int ret = imap[ind];
		if (imap[ind] < 0) {
			a[pos] = x;
			map[pos] = ind;
			imap[ind] = pos;
			pos++;
			up(pos - 1);
		}
		return ret != -1 ? a[ret] : x;
	}
	int update(int ind, int x) {
		int ret = imap[ind];
		if (imap[ind] < 0) {
			a[pos] = x;
			map[pos] = ind;
			imap[ind] = pos;
			pos++;
			up(pos - 1);
		}
		else {
			int o = a[ret];
			a[ret] = x;
			up(ret);
			down(ret);
		}
		return x;
	}
	int remove(int ind) {
		if (pos == 1)return INF;
		if (imap[ind] == -1)return INF;
		pos--;
		int rem = imap[ind];
		int ret = a[rem];
		map[rem] = map[pos];
		imap[map[pos]] = rem;
		imap[ind] = -1;
		a[rem] = a[pos];
		a[pos] = INF;
		map[pos] = -1;
		up(rem);
		down(rem);
		return ret;
	}
	int min() { return a[1]; }
	int argmin() { return map[1]; }
	int size() { return pos - 1; }
	void up(int cur) {
		for (int c = cur, p = c >> 1; p >= 1 && a[p] > a[c]; c >>= 1, p >>= 1) {
			int d = a[p];
			a[p] = a[c];
			a[c] = d;
			int e = imap[map[p]];
			imap[map[p]] = imap[map[c]];
			imap[map[c]] = e;
			e = map[p];
			map[p] = map[c];
			map[c] = e;
		}
	}
	void down(int cur) {
		for (int c = cur; 2 * c < pos;) {
			int b = a[2 * c] < a[2 * c + 1] ? 2 * c : 2 * c + 1;
			if (a[b] < a[c]) {
				int d = a[c];
				a[c] = a[b];
				a[b] = d;
				int e = imap[map[c]];
				imap[map[c]] = imap[map[b]];
				imap[map[b]] = e;
				e = map[c];
				map[c] = map[b];
				map[b] = e;
				c = b;
			}
			else {
				break;
			}
		}
	}
};

void solve() {
	int n = 0;
	cin >> n;
	char* s = new char[n];
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		cin >> s[i];
	}
	int* f = new int[26];
	for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++)f[i] = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)f[s[i] - 'a']++;
	for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
		if (f[i] > n / 2) {
			cout << -1 << endl;
			return;
		}
	}
	int* a = new int[n];
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		cin >> a[i];
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
		if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
			int d = a[i];
			a[i] = a[n - 1 - i];
			a[n - 1 - i] = d;
			char u = s[i];
			s[i] = s[n - 1 - i];
			s[n - 1 - i] = u;
		}
	}
	vector<Edge> es;
	int src = n;
	int sink = n + 1;
	for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
		es.push_back({ src, i, 1, 0 });
		es.push_back({ n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0 });
		for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
			if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
				es.push_back({ i, n - 1 - j, 1, i == j ? 0 : a[i] });
			}
		}
	}
	long ans = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)ans += a[i];
	Edge* g = compileWD(sink + 1, es);
	MinHeap q(n + 2);
	int* d = new int[n + 2];
	for (int i = 0; i < n + 2; i++)d[i] = INF;
	d[src] = 0;
	q.add(src, 0);
	while (q.size() > 0) {
		int cur = q.argmin();
		q.remove(cur);
		for (Edge& ne : g[cur]) {
			if (ne.capacity - ne.flow > 0) {
				int nd = d[cur] + ne.cost + d[cur] - d[ne.to];
				if (d[ne.to] > nd) {
					d[ne.to] = nd;
					q.update(ne.to, nd);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if (d[sink] == INF) {
		cout << ans << endl;
		return;
	}
	long minflow = 0;
	long sumcost = 0;
	for (Edge* e = &es[sink]; e != nullptr; e = e->complement) {
		if (e->capacity - e->flow < minflow)minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
		sumcost += e->cost;
	}
	ans -= minflow * sumcost;
	for (Edge* e = &es[sink]; e != nullptr; e = e->complement) {
		e->flow += minflow;
		e->complement->flow -= minflow;
	}
}
